description: FLOW: measures whether AutoProgressionService's imbue-axis dispatch (AutoImbuePlanner + AutoImbueExecutor) can drive party imbue coverage toward 1.0 within a balanced farming+imbuing budget. Axes are (startingImbueCoverage x playerLevel x dangerLevel). Cells proxy the outcome via the standard combat sim — at each cell, if auto-imbue can pick a viable reagent + open slot, the combat win-rate should match the tolerance band below. Proxy: starting coverage 0.25 @ level 5 should reach coverage ~0.75 within ~30 simulated minutes (3 imbue cycles). Bands are baseline; creative agent revisits once live telemetry lands.
